message.content: Columbia University is a private Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States and is known for its rigorous academic programs, distinguished faculty, and notable alumni, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and U.S. presidents. The university comprises several undergraduate schools (e.g., Columbia College, School of Engineering & Applied Science) and graduate schools (e.g., Columbia Law School, Columbia Business School, Columbia Graduate School of Arts and Sciences). Its main campus is situated on Morningside Heights in Manhattan, with additional campuses in Washington, D.C. (Columbia Law School), and other locations worldwide.
